items.title: T-Mobile Launches Credit Card With 2% Cashback, No FTF, 5% + $125, $5 Discount
items.why: Carriers are using co-brand cards to deepen ecosystem lock-in, a pattern worth tracking for telco-style partner pitches.
items.summary_ai: T-Mobile launched a Visa card with 2% flat cash back, a per-line auto-pay discount, and 5% back on T-Mobile purchases.
items.take: Carriers are using co-brand cards to deepen ecosystem lock-in, a pattern worth tracking for telco-style partner pitches.

items.title: T-Mobile Chase Offer: Get up to $50 back on wireless payments
items.why: A card-linked offer tied to a recurring telecom bill is a template for a wireless carrier partnership.
items.summary_ai: Chase is offering a 15% cash back deal on T-Mobile wireless plan payments, capped at $50.
items.take: A card-linked offer tied to a recurring telecom bill is a template for a wireless carrier partnership.
